title: Project Accounting, Professional
jobDescription: Job Summary Iron Mountain is seeking a skilled and highly motivated Senior Manager, Capital Accounting & Project Portfolio Management (PPM) to join our Global Controllership team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end fixed asset lifecycle, leading the capital-related month-end close, and ensuring robust Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance across dual US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) frameworks. You will serve as a critical financial partner to our Design & Construction and regional business teams, driving process optimization across our expanding global footprint. What You’ll Do In this role, you will: Responsibility 1 (Main Responsibility & Outputs): Manage the end-to-end Project Portfolio Management (PPM) and capital lifecycle within Oracle—from project creation and cost collection to Construction in Progress (CIP) reconciliation and final capitalization—ensuring accurate, timely depreciation and policy compliance. Responsibility 2 (Collaboration & Outcomes): Collaborate as a key finance partner with Regional Operations, Design & Construction, and Capital Expenditure Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) teams to monitor "Placed in Service" dates, deliver comprehensive variance analysis, and support new asset acquisitions. Responsibility 3 (Compliance & Standards): Ensure strict compliance with US GAAP, Ind AS, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls by leading month-end close reviews, approving balance sheet reconciliations, and coordinating internal and external audits. What You’ll Bring The ideal candidate will have: 8 to 12 years of progressive accounting experience in a multinational environment, with a dedicated focus on real estate construction accounting, capital deployment, and the "Record to Report" process. Strong knowledge of dual reporting frameworks (US GAAP/ASC 842 and Ind AS) and advanced proficiency in Oracle Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, specifically PPM and Fixed Assets. Proven ability in operating within a global matrix structure, driving process automation between subledgers and the General Ledger, and managing complex stakeholder relationships across multiple time zones. Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) professional designation. jobDescription: Job Summary Iron Mountain is seeking a skilled and proactive Data Center Network & Security Operations Lead to join our IT Infrastructure & Security team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring maximum network uptime across data centers, disaster recovery sites, and office locations while managing network security, firewalls, and incident escalations in a continuous 24/7/365 environment. - Warehouse & Technology to join our Warehouse & Logistics Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for serving as the technical authority for our warehouse and logistics technology ecosystem, defining and governing architecture standards, and owning the future-state warehouse technology roadmaps. The Warehouse & Logistics Technology team bridges enterprise IT and operational environments, ensuring our global supply chain platforms, infrastructure, automation systems, and integrations are secure, resilient, and aligned with long-term business objectives. What You’ll Do In this role, you will: Architecture Governance & Strategy : Define architecture principles, reference architectures, and future-state technology roadmaps while serving as the highest-level escalation point and technical approval authority for major initiatives. Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) Leadership : Provide enterprise architecture direction across Manhattan Scale, SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and future Warehouse Management Systems, aligning business processes with end-to-end operational workflows. Enterprise Integration Architecture : Own design and governance standards for real-time and batch system integrations—including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), Event-Driven Architectures, and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI/B2B)—ensuring absolute visibility of data flows across critical systems. Infrastructure, Automation & Operational Technology (OT) : Govern warehouse infrastructure environments (including enterprise Wi-Fi, edge computing, and device management) and partner with automation vendors to securely integrate Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), Warehouse Execution Systems (WES), and Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS). Security, Observability & Resiliency : Partner with security teams to enforce Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Zero Trust principles, while establishing operational standards for monitoring, disaster recovery, and peak-season business continuity. What You’ll Bring The ideal candidate will have: 15+ years of overall technology experience, with 7+ years specifically in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or Principal Architect roles. Deep experience supporting warehouse technology ecosystems and a comprehensive understanding of warehouse operations and supply chain execution processes. Proven expertise with Manhattan Scale, SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), or equivalent enterprise Warehouse Management Systems. Advanced knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, cloud-native environments (such as Google Cloud Platform), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems (including ANSI X12, EDIFACT, AS2, Secure File Transfer Protocol [SFTP], and Value-Added Network [VAN] providers). Strong infrastructure, networking, and security architecture expertise supporting mission-critical, high-volume operational environments. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (The Open Group Architecture Framework [TOGAF], Google Cloud, or Security architecture certifications are highly preferred).
